figureAudit.note: decksTotal counts transcribed decks; 'available' counts the 2026 edition's nine decks only. Lecture 1's deck was transcribed by Sonnet from its native 1280x720 page JPEGs and audited by a separate Sonnet agent on 14 table-, chart-, number- and code-heavy pages (2, 6, 19, 25, 31, 52, 53, 57, 75, 81, 82, 93, 97, 98): 0 discrepancies. The parent model also checked the images of slides 39 and 106 and a crop of slide 86.

images.format: whole slides, the deck's own 1280x720 page JPEGs extracted byte for byte, named slide-N by PDF page number
images.discovery: inline in wiki/ and raw/slides/; no index file
images.note: Lecture 1: 34 of 108 pages, every slide with a distinct figure. Not included: logistics, logos, portraits and prize/stock photos, decorative slides, text-only slides, code and tables transcribed exactly, and build steps contained in an included slide; the lists are in BUILD_LOG.md. No other lecture is in this KB, so none has images.

caveats: Covers lecture 1 of the 2026 edition only: 1 of the catalog's 90 recordings.

The deck is a flattened PDF with no text layer and no printed slide numbers. Slide N is PDF page N, and everything in raw/slides/ was read visually from 1280x720 page images; there is no higher-resolution source.
Transcripts are YouTube auto-captions, lightly copy-edited. The verbatim captions are in raw/transcripts/original/.
Slide images are 1280x720, the deck's native resolution, below the 1400px used in sibling KBs.
Some slide code is reproduced as printed, including the slide's own slips (slide 82's tf.keras.optimizer, slide 86's update step); the slide file notes each one.
